alts: Why Your 'Free' Game Costs $4,000 a Year
Why You Never Win the Dragon in a 'Free' Game
line1: A free dragon game costs Dave $235 in 3 weeks. How does a game that costs $0 get you to pay — and who's taking it?
summary: Dave downloads a free dragon game for his bus ride with one rule: never pay a cent. Three weeks later, the game has taken $234.95. In this video, you'll see how free-to-play mobile games are designed to hide the real dollar cost behind gems and pulls, why about 4 in 100 players pay for everyone, and the one sentence that turns gems back into dollars before you tap buy.
